# Texture streaming fixture

- `FlightHelmet_Materials_LensesMat_BaseColor.ktx2`: from `Models/FlightHelmet/glTF-KTX-BasisU` of
  https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets (CC0-1.0). 1,024 by 1,024, 11 levels, ETC1S. The GPU check of the whole
  model reads all 17 files from `MARGO_SPLAT_SAMPLES/helmet`; at 33 MB they stay out of the repository.
